title: Towny Religions
description: Towny Religion is a Towny 1.20.1 addon that adds religions for towns and nations. Create and develop your faith, unlock new stages and rituals. Supports 7 languages and extensive customization.
body:
**Towny Religion**

Towny Religion is an addon for the Towny plugin for Minecraft 1.20.1 that introduces a religion system for towns and nations.

Town mayors can create their own religions with a custom name, color, and description. Other towns and entire nations can join these religions and unite under the same faith.

Develop your religion, earn faith points, unlock new progression stages, and gain access to powerful rituals. The plugin currently features 5 religion stages.

**Features:**

 Create custom religions.
 Customize religion name, color, and description.
 Allow towns and nations to join religions.
 Faith and progression system.
 5 religion development stages.
 Unlock and perform rituals.
 Support for 7 languages.
 Highly configurable with almost every feature customizable through configuration files.

**Use the command:**

/t religion help

to view the full list of available commands.
